# EvCommandItem

> One command in a Command palette: a leading icon, a label, an optional shortcut cap, and a check when it is the chosen row.

| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:command-item` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |

| Source | `src/atoms/command-item/EvCommandItem.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner element `.ev-command-item`, not the root |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:command-group` (EvCommandGroup) |

## Example

```vue

  label="Buat faktur baru"
  active
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Command**, frame `4220:73205` (Command). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Give power users fast keyboard access to actions, navigation, and search across the app — triggered by ⌘K / Ctrl+K from anywhere.

### When not to use

- As the only way to reach an action. On simple apps with few commands — a visible menu or buttons are clearer.

### Do

- Group commands into clear sections. Show keyboard shortcuts (Kbd) for frequent actions. Keep labels action-first (verbs).

### Don't

- Don't bury critical actions only here. Don't list hundreds of flat commands without grouping or search.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvCommandItem`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner element `.ev-command-item`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:command-item` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
